key.name: mode
key.description: manual: only by hand. sunset: dark from sunset to sunrise. custom: at light-time and dark-time.

key.name: light-time
key.description: With mode custom, the style turns light at this time. Also used by sunset when no location is known.

key.name: dark-time
key.description: With mode custom, the style turns dark at this time. Also used by sunset when no location is known.

key.name: pair-wallpaper
key.description: On: a wallpaper that comes in a light and a dark picture (name-light.png, name-dark.png) shows the one that matches the style. Off: the picture stays the same in both styles.

key.name: follow-legacy-theme
key.summary: GTK 3 apps follow the accent and the style
key.description: GTK 3 apps cannot read the accent colour or the style, so the GTK theme name carries them (Vitre-Glass, Vitre-Glass-Green-Light and so on). Only changed while a Vitre-Glass theme is in use.

key.name: hold-until
key.description: Seconds since 1970. When the style is changed by hand, the schedule leaves it alone until its next switch. 0 = no hold.

key.name: last-coordinates
key.description: Latitude and longitude rounded to two decimals, used only while Location Services is on. (91, 181) = none.

key.name: status
key.summary: What the schedule did (internal, read by Vitre Settings)
key.description: (source, last switch, next switch, next is dark): source is location, timezone, none, custom or manual; times in seconds since 1970, 0 = none.
